content: With these two sequences, we concatenate INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 along the sequence length dimension to generate the sequence INLINEFORM2 . Since we have employed several GRU layers to encode the sequential inputs, another recurrent layer may be redundant. Therefore, we utilize a 1-layer CNN BIBREF18 to capture the local structure and generate the representation vector for the final prediction.
